projectDescription: A decentralized, end-to-end encrypted chat application built on the EVIL protocol — your messages are signed, encrypted, and relay-blind from the moment you type.
keyFeatures: End-to-end encrypted channels and direct messages — relays never see plaintext
Self-sovereign identity via Ed25519 keypairs (DID-based, no accounts or passwords)
Decentralized relay architecture — anyone can run their own relay
Sealed-sender direct messages — relay cannot see who sent a DM
MLS (Messaging Layer Security) group encryption for channels
Append-only event log with client-side projection — tamper-evident message history
evilvault daemon — self-hosted, Storage-Key-encrypted permanent archive
Web and mobile (iOS, Android, macOS) clients via Blazor and MAUI
Message reactions, editing, deletion, and moderation (bans, moderator grants)
Command palette (⌘K) for quick navigation and full-text message search
Proof-of-work spam protection on relay ingress
Jinx design system with dark/light theme support
publicApiSurface: GET /info — relay parameters (PoW difficulty, rate caps, retention TTL)
POST /events — submit a signed envelope to the relay
POST /archive — vault: batch upsert of re-encrypted VaultRecords
GET /archive?streamId&fromTs&toTs&limit — vault: range query by stream and timestamp
GET /status — vault: count, DB size, uptime
evilvault init — initialize vault config and print pairing token
evilvault config get|set — read/update port and data directory
evilvault token rotate — generate new bearer token
evilvault status — query running daemon status
SignedEnvelope wire format (JSON): EventId, Kind, AuthorDid, Timestamp, StreamId, PrevEventHash, PowNonce, Payload, Signature
EnvelopeKind enum: Identity, Encrypted, KeySeal, Mls, Sealed
Domain events: IdentityAnnounced, ChannelCreated, MessageSent, MessageDeleted, MessageEdited, MessageReacted, MemberBanned, ModeratorGranted, RoomKeyDistributed, DeviceAuthorized, DeviceRevoked
